title: The agent guard denies refspec and compound push lines and protects its own script; gh api and mvn are not blanket-allowed

criteria.given: the issue's steps 1 to 6 are piped to the guard as tool calls
criteria.then: every one is denied (exit 2): refspec destinations (HEAD:development, feature/x:main, +HEAD:development, :development), compound lines, -fu / +refspec / --mirror force spellings, an unsignoffed compound git commit, fully-qualified mvn deploy goals, gh pr merge --admin after cd, and absolute or ../ spellings of .claude/settings.json and of scripts/agent-guard.sh itself
allow no longer carries Bash(gh api:*) or a blanket Bash(mvn:*)/Bash(mvn -B:*)/Bash(mvn -pl:*), Bash(mvn exec:*) is ask-first, and deny mirrors the secret-path Read denies for Bash cat/grep

criteria.given: routine read-only commands (git status, mvn verify, gh pr view, a feature-branch push, --force-with-lease)

criteria.then: it matches the behaviour: gh api behind a prompt, mvn exec:* ask-first, and the guard script itself protected
